The actual maximum is 150.\\nAutomatic entry picks the first usable entry point, or the map exit if there is none.\\nEntry points 1–8 are the numbers from the full terrain editor. A missing or blocked point is rejected by the game check.\\nNew settings are not added to existing saves. Start a new scenario.
